text_en: This book is a mystery story for children.
The main character is Kim, a curious girl who lives in an old town.
At the beginning of the story, a magic lantern disappears during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
Kim follows the clues and meets some funny characters.
The illustrations are colourful and beautiful.
The plot is exciting, and I couldn't stop reading!
In the end, Kim solves the mystery and saves the festival.
The moral of the story is that you should never give up.
I recommend this book to everyone who loves mysteries.
